contract.notes: Pins the OIDC discovery bootstrap's T8 cases. Each case is executed by the Go, TypeScript, and Python loader tests against a real local HTTP(S) server; no network egress to real hosts. The bootstrap fetches the configured OIDC discovery document once, verifies its issuer equals the configured upstream issuer, and takes jwks_uri from it; every failure fails closed.

host_guard.default: reject any endpoint host that is not a public address
host_guard.override: allowPrivateHosts (Go, TypeScript) / allow_private_hosts (Python); off by default, never enabled by the framework
host_guard.enforced_at: connect time, on the address the name actually resolved to, so there is no DNS-rebinding window between the check and the connection
host_guard.notes: An IPv4-mapped IPv6 address is classified by the IPv4 address it maps to (for example ::ffff:127.0.0.1 is loopback). The guard applies to both the discovery fetch and every JWKS fetch. The public rows are genuinely globally reachable addresses: documentation/test ranges are deliberately absent because language runtimes disagree about whether they count as private.

cases.name: same-origin-https-accepted
cases.scenario: discovery document served over HTTPS with issuer equal to the configured issuer

cases.name: issuer-mismatch-rejected
cases.scenario: discovery document issuer differs from the configured issuer

cases.name: cross-origin-redirect-rejected
cases.scenario: the discovery fetch responds with a redirect to a different origin

cases.name: missing-jwks-uri-rejected
cases.scenario: a valid discovery document that omits jwks_uri
